SET decide_frame_limit=3; SELECT id, x FROM (VALUES (1, 'A', 1, 4, 2), (2, 'A', 2, 6, 1), (3, 'A', 3, 1, 3), (4, 'B', 1, 7, 2), (5, 'B', 2, 3, 1)) t(id, product, period, v, w) DECIDE x(INT)
        SUCH THAT x <= at(previous else 0: t.v) over (t.period) AND x <= sum(from first to last: t.v) over (t.id) MAXIMIZE sum(x)

any.stderr: Invalid Input Error: DECIDE: sum(from first to last: t.v) over (t.id) reads more than 3 values over its ranges, above decide_frame_limit (3). Narrow the range, or raise the setting.
